phases.label: Now / Version Zero
phases.title: A working reference, and an open call.
phases.summary: Assembly notes, CAD, firmware, the operator dashboard, and both dispense recordings are in the repository. The open problems are the ones a second lab would hit first.

phases.label: Next / Lab-ready version
phases.title: Make the reference easier to repeat.
phases.summary: Interfaces, adaptable dispensing, deployment notes, and pilot criteria are proposals. Nothing in this column is a finished lab kit.

phases.label: Future / Public network launch
phases.title: A directory only after the program is real.
phases.summary: Standards, applications, a defined Seeed support model, and public machine listings come after pilot evidence. This stage is not launched.

items.title: Assembly documentation
items.description: Bill of materials, wiring, and a photographed build sequence for the reference machine.

items.title: Source CAD
items.description: STEP case files and STL parts for the reference enclosure, frame, dispenser, and interface.

items.title: Wio Terminal firmware
items.description: Customer reader firmware plus bring-up sketches. The controller is a Wio Terminal, not a XIAO board.

items.title: Backend and operator dashboard
items.description: CSV-backed Node.js server with Operate, Inventory, and Config pages.

items.title: Direct-order dispensing
items.description: A recorded pass that releases every product on a direct-order card.

items.title: Balance-card dispensing
items.description: A recorded pass that lets the customer select products on the Wio screen.

items.title: Exploded machine viewer
items.description: Browser view of the Version Zero parts. Positions are for explanation, not assembly coordinates.

items.title: Dispensing improvements
items.description: The four-column mechanism works for the reference geometry. Other product sizes still need designed, tested replacements.

items.title: Standardized machine interfaces
items.description: Shared mounting and connection points so a lab can swap a module without redrawing the whole machine.

items.title: Modifiable dispensing mechanisms
items.description: A defined way to add another release mechanism while keeping the column interface.

items.title: Product size adaptability
items.description: Documented envelopes for products the reference columns can and cannot carry.

items.title: Electronics and control improvements
items.description: Future controller or wiring changes. This does not change the fact that Version Zero uses Wio Terminal hardware.

items.title: Deployment documentation
items.description: Notes a second lab would need beyond the single reference build: placement, power, network, and handoff.

items.title: Reliability and safety testing
items.description: Repeated dispense trials, failure notes, and maintenance checks. No test report is published yet.

items.title: XIAO supply and merchandising
items.description: A proposed default product category. Supply terms, quantities, and pricing are not confirmed.

items.title: Pilot-lab criteria
items.description: Who could host a pilot, and what evidence would count. No application is open.

items.title: Lab operation and restocking
items.description: A written restock routine for more than the reference dashboard's inventory page.

items.title: Published machine standards
items.description: Accepted interface and documentation rules. Every current proposal is still an idea.

items.title: Repeatable deployment instructions
items.description: A kit a lab can follow without reconstructing the reference from chat and source trees.

items.title: Fab Lab application process
items.description: A future way for a lab to apply. The current path is a GitHub issue, reviewed by a person.

items.title: Defined Seeed support model
items.description: What Seeed Studio would actually supply, and on what terms. Not written.

items.title: Lab verification and onboarding
items.description: A review before a machine appears on the public map as verified.

items.title: Worldwide machine directory
items.description: The map page can show directory data and verified machines. No verified installation is published.

items.title: Product discovery
items.description: A public list of products at a machine, with a difference between a listing and confirmed availability.

items.title: New machine announcements
items.description: A feed of submitted and approved installations. The feed is empty until a review approves one.

items.title: Community maintenance
items.description: An ongoing way to accept replacements, correct listings, and retire bad data.
